notes: Universal systems (docs/specs/universal-systems.md). Every number here is a first guess, to be tuned in training mode. DEVOTION: written in Devotion points; a bar is barSize points and a character holds stats.meterBars bars (4 = 400). unit = how many game units one point is (the game only keeps whole numbers; don't change it). exCost = an EX move. superCost = by a super's 'level' (1 or 3); a move can set its own with 'meterCost'. gain (before the character's multipliers): hitPerPct = the attacker, per 1% of the opponent's max health dealt (x give); blockedPerPct = the attacker, per 1% the blocked hit would have done (x give); special = doing a special move (x give); perfectLink (x give); hurtPerPct = the defender, per 1% of their max health lost (x take); vowAbsorb = a hit absorbed by Vow gives this share of what taking it would (x take). Whiffs give nothing. takeCapPerCombo = the most Devotion one combo can give the fighter taking it. ARCHETYPES: presets a character picks with meter: { archetype } in its file, and may override (give, take, extras). extras: vowAbsorb (replaces the rule's share), perfectLink (replaces the rule's amount), witness (flat, on a Witness counter), guardPerPct (the defender builds this per 1% blocked), repel (flat, on a Repel), drawRefund (share of Draw's cost returned by a punish), variety { newMove (x gain for a move new to the combo), repeat (x gain for a move already used in it), switch (flat, when a hit changes between high and low, or the attacker changes side) }. COUNTER: a hit during the opponent's startup frames (or the active frames of a normal): hitstun x 'hitstun', plus hitstopAdd frames of hitstop, damage x 'damage'. WITNESS: a hit during the opponent's recovery frames, or during the active frames of a special or super that has touched nothing: hitstun x 'hitstun'; the first softHits hits of that combo scale the combo by only (1 - soften) of what they normally would; the combo's hitstun-decay timer and tech-out point come decayExtend frames later; slowFrames of slow motion (drawing only). PERFECT LINK: the next attack pressed during the last 'window' frames of a hit's hitstop; at most maxPerCombo per combo. VOW (M+H on the ground, no motion): startup = frames before the guard is up; maxHold = frames held (counted from the press) before it releases by itself; absorbHitstop = the short freeze on each absorbed hit; strikeAt / fullAt = frames held for the normal strike / the full strike (less than strikeAt = the quick strike); cancelCost = Devotion to cancel a normal into Vow (free from neutral); dashCost = Devotion to dash out of the guard; debtDrainFrames = Debt left when Vow ends without landing the strike drains away over this long; debtPenalty = getting hit while Debt remains costs the Debt plus this share of it; crumpleStun = frames of the crumple; witnessWindow = the strike is a Witness counter if the opponent was in an attack's active or recovery frames within this many frames. Supers, throws and moves with 'pierce': true go through the guard. moves = the three strikes, in the normal move format (frame data, hitboxes; 'crumple': true = the crumple reaction on a grounded hit); a character can lay its own fields (art, boxes) over any of them by listing a move with the same id.
